- Build a complete, playable first-person 3D cricket game in the existing project.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

- Implemented the game as a standalone HTML/CSS/Canvas project with an original stadium scene and first-person batting controls.
- Assumed a practice match of two overs, with a target of 24 runs.

- Created `index.html` with the game HUD, scoreboard, start/end overlays, and controls.
- Created `style.css` with responsive desktop/mobile layouts and game UI styling.
- Added most of the Canvas game implementation to `game.js`.

- Run the game in a browser, inspect a screenshot, and fix any gameplay or visual issues.

2. Resolve the duplicate/malformed content and run `node --check game.js`.
3. Launch the page, test batting and match flow, save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot, then fix issues.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page structure and interface elements.
- `style.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI.
- `game.js`: Rendering, controls, score logic, and match progression; currently syntactically invalid.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `game.js` has already been partially built, but the latest edit introduced a duplicate script prefix; verify the entire file before continuing.
